class.description: Emits the ScalarBound constraints of the vehicle kinematics
Builds the drivable area from the lane bounds of the lanelets on the route
Takes the reference_path widened by a constant half width and extended at both ends as the drivable area, emitted as two boundaries
Emits one rigid-body KeepOut per predicted object, along its most likely predicted path
Samples terminal states in Frenet coordinates and joins them with quintic polynomials, then takes the cheapest candidate that passes the projected views of the constraint IR
The default planner: runs the rough planner and then the trajectory optimizer for each constraint set
Solves the trajectory as a time-parameterized non-convex NLP
Solves a piecewise Bezier over (s, l, t) cubes as a convex QP (SSC, arXiv:1906.09788)
